text: The Florence Nightingale David Award is presented every two years, specifically in odd-numbered years, jointly by the Committee of Presidents of Statistical Societies and the Caucus for Women in Statistics, to a distinguished female statistician. The award aims to recognize a female statistician who embodies the contributions of Florence Nightingale David and who has advanced the field of statistics while serving as an outstanding role model. Since its establishment, the award has become a prestigious hallmark of achievement within the community of female statisticians.
